state: Sellers maintain the immediate downward advantage, but high chop and erratic structure prevent a clean trend.
paragraphs: Sellers hold the immediate advantage as price rests at 61.0, having pushed below the latest confirmed low at 63.0. Confirmed swing structure aligns with this downward movement through a series of lower highs and lower lows. The most recent downside extension reached 5 units in length, showing that selling pressure is finding room to develop even inside a compressed volatility range. At the same time, the broader market background remains disorderly. High chop readings and inconsistent timing prevent the decline from establishing a clean trend. Price is moving lower, but control continues to change hands with enough frequency to keep the wider structure unsettled. The immediate move has force, yet it operates within an erratic environment that lacks persistent follow-through.

Across the broader 104-run window, selling and buying moves show a fairly even historical balance, with average bearish runs measuring 2.5 units against average bullish runs of 2.33. Recent behavior tightens that comparison. Over the last 12 runs, the average bearish extension holds near 2.33 while counter-moves shrink to an average of 1.83. Selling pressure is maintaining a slight edge in length as counter-moves contract. That shift shows up clearly in the latest sequence, where downward stretches have begun reaching 4 and 5 units while bullish responses struggle to match that scale. Even though the wider environment remains choppy, selling persistence has gradually improved against weaker buying attempts.

The quality of control remains erratic as sellers press lower. Low timing consistency and high chop readings show that the decline is happening inside an unstable background instead of a clean trend. Volatility is compressed with contracting band width, meaning fresh expansion is not yet building behind the downward movement. Re-acceleration sits low at 8.8 and continuation registers at 37.2, confirming that the move lacks smooth internal traction. Opposing wick pressure remains subdued at 22.0, showing that buyers are offering little immediate rejection. Price has downward force, but the environment stays disorganized enough that the current control rests on shifting ground.

Support sits immediately below at the regression line resting at 60.53192, reinforced by nearby confirmed low pivots down toward the 60.0 area. That zone gives the current decline a nearby floor, even if selling pressure remains active. Overhead, the first reclaim area spans from the Bollinger lower band at 61.27233 and the recent low pivot at 62.0 up to the broken swing low at 63.0. Price must navigate that immediate friction before any broader recovery can take shape. Higher up, a larger barrier zone clusters around the Bollinger middle band at 64.9, SAR at 66.7232, and the Gartley pattern completion level at 67.54. That heavier ceiling defines the wider boundary sellers must respect to keep the downward pressure intact.

The current downside run maintains its momentum because buyers are failing to generate meaningful rejection. Opposing wick pressure rests low at 22.0, showing that bids are sparse as price probes the 61.0 area. At the same time, the broader volatility envelope remains broad yet contracting. That means room exists for downward extension, but fresh volatility expansion is not actively building behind the move. Contracting volatility serves as a caution instead of proof that the decline will easily persist without interruption. A developing Gartley pattern with its D point positioned at 67.54 adds a layer of harmonic counter-pressure overhead. That pattern does not reverse the bearish reading on its own, but it introduces an active source of resistance that could stall the move if selling pressure softens.

The broader market background remains unresolved due to persistent chop, erratic timing, and frequent reversals. That background settles only if volatility transitions into an orderly stable range or yields to persistent directional control. The immediate bearish lean gains more conviction if sellers reduce instability and establish repeated downside extensions with steadier timing and continued structural progress. Conversely, that downward bias weakens if buyers reclaim broken structure, initiate longer counter-runs, or cause a loss of same-side persistence. Until one of those structural shifts takes hold, the market stays locked in a compressed environment where sellers hold the immediate advantage without having forged a clean trend.
